summary: No new receipt this turn, so I strengthened the record in two ways. First, I revised the existing Behavior knowledge entry (by its id, with no semantic change) so that its relied-on evidence now includes the resurrected-voter receipt (226f9762f0b444f69c154b35fe0788f3, membership and premature commit) and the forgotten-added-voter receipt (b1daa1f4c9444b8d857bc7e0ab761691, understated quorum) alongside the dual-majority truncation receipt, and I narrowed its source list to the sources actually cited by that behaviour. Second, I requested one repeat of the original restart probe — the most cited witness of the empty-configuration case, which also carries both its in-harness controls (non-replay and snapshot) in a single execution — to confirm the primary witness and its controls reproduce together.
